api_checks.description: GET /api/verification-queue as user 3; expect 3 items oldest first with document_id, application_id 1, type
POST /api/documents/1/verify -> 200 as user 3 {VERIFIED, reason}; expect verified_by 3, audit DOCUMENT_VERIFIED, item gone from queue
POST /api/documents/2/verify -> 200 as user 3 {REJECTED, reason}; expect audit DOCUMENT_REJECTED, application still SUBMITTED
POST /api/documents/1/verify -> 422 with missing, empty, and 501-char reason; expect VALIDATION_ERROR and no audit row
GET /api/verification-queue -> 403 with CUSTOMER token; also POST /api/documents/1/verify -> 403; re-POST on a VERIFIED document -> 409 ALREADY_VERIFIED
POST /api/applications/{id}/underwrite for the AC case; expect AUTO_APPROVE, 740, SCORE_MEETS_AUTO_APPROVE, v1, APPROVED, one ApplicationApproved event
POST /api/applications/2/underwrite -> 200 for age 30/60000.00; expect MANUAL_REVIEW, SCORE_IN_REVIEW_BAND, status MANUAL_REVIEW
POST /api/applications/3/underwrite -> 200 for age 30/30000.00/prior_default; expect AUTO_REJECT, SCORE_BELOW_MIN, REJECTED
POST /api/applications/4/underwrite -> 200 for age 70/100000.00; expect AUTO_REJECT with reason_codes exactly [AGE_OUT_OF_RANGE]
POST /api/applications/{A}/underwrite -> 200 and POST /api/applications/{B}/underwrite -> 200 after approving v2 between submissions; A v1 MANUAL_REVIEW score 640, B v2 AUTO_REJECT INCOME_BELOW_MIN
POST /api/applications/{id}/underwrite -> 409 on a DRAFT (NOT_SUBMITTED) and on a decided application (ALREADY_DECIDED, stored decision unchanged)
